quest.51301130F8B93E94.quest_desc: Prepare the listed blocks for autocrafting and external processing. The tasks detect inventory components; completion does not prove the system is built or running.
For a test bench, add 1k Crafting Storage, power, storage and a terminal. Put the Provider beside the Assembler, encode a plank recipe and request a small batch.
Then configure a separate Processing Pattern for the Infuser: item input, the correct infusion material and product return. Check completion in the CPU’s job status.
quest.51301130F8B93E94.title: ME Workshop Components
quest.5130113398623BDE.quest_desc: The sixth milestone opens late transmutation. Antimatter Pellet requires SPS power infrastructure; collecting ordinary resources alone cannot reach this stage.
Eight cores require 1 Antimatter Pellet, 2 Mythic Circuit, 2 Gaia Ingot and 4 Calorite Ingot. Have the completed core detected before spending it on late recipes.
The finale combines ProjectE results from chapter 25, Infinity Ingot from chapter 26, antimatter and Mythic Circuit. Its task list shows the exact quantities and prerequisites.

quest.5130115E1ED084F6.quest_desc: The second milestone combines metallurgy and processors. Its quest prerequisites include the chassis, steel plate, Mekanism alloys and an AE2 Calculation Processor.

One batch yields 2 mechanisms from 2 Redstone Alloy, 2 Calculation Processor, 2 Infused Alloy, 1 Industrial Chassis and 2 Electromechanical Drive. Test each production line before assembling the batch.

A compact ME network and first autocrafting setup are now available: a Pattern Provider, Molecular Assembler and a CPU with 1k Crafting Storage. A plain Crafting Unit is not a working CPU by itself. Components of 4k and above remain behind Dimensional Matrix.
Next prepare Dimensional Matrix: workshop-made Vibrant Alloy and Terrasteel, Enchanted Gravitite from Aether and Fiery Ingot from Twilight Forest. These supplies can be developed in parallel.
quest.5130115E1ED084F6.quest_subtitle: Precision machinery and the first ME autocrafting
quest.5130115E1ED084F6.title: Precision Mechanism
quest.5130117F2402AE8A.quest_desc: The fourth milestone links space and the DivineRPG island worlds. It requires Desh Plate from the lunar branch, Eden Chunk, Elite Control Circuit and Dimensional Matrix.
Four Stellar Alloy require 4 Desh Plate, 2 Dimensional Matrix, 2 Eden Chunk and 1 Elite Control Circuit. Keep part of the batch for the next shared components.
Mythic Circuit needs three routes: DivineRPG world progression through Mortum, Botania's Gaia branch and Mekanism Ultimate Control Circuit. Prepare power and cooling separately from reactor ignition.

quest.513011AA869D0649.quest_desc: The third milestone joins Ender IO, Botania, Aether and Twilight Forest. Its quest prerequisites lead to specific materials from those branches alongside Precision Mechanism.

Two matrices require 2 Vibrant Alloy, 2 Terrasteel Ingot, 2 Precision Mechanism, 1 Enchanted Gravitite and 2 Fiery Ingot. This quest does not require every Aether dungeon or every item in the forest catalogue.

The matrix opens larger AE2 components and space preparation. Before the first flight, build and fuel a rocket, prepare a complete spacesuit, oxygen and a return plan. Detecting the spacesuit item does not verify its oxygen reserve.
Next prepare Stellar Alloy: lunar Desh, DivineRPG Eden Chunk and a Mekanism Elite Control Circuit.
quest.513011AA869D0649.quest_subtitle: Materials from magic and the first dimensions
quest.513011AA869D0649.title: Dimensional Matrix
quest.513011AEA75E4401.quest_desc: The fifth milestone depends on Mortum Chunk, Gaia Ingot, Ultimate Control Circuit and Stellar Alloy: material results from several developed branches.

Two circuits cost 4 Mortum Chunk, 2 Ultimate Control Circuit, 2 Gaia Ingot and 1 Stellar Alloy. Your team must first actually manufacture the circuit. It can then appear in masterwork packs from reward level 5; random rewards cannot replace that first craft.
Next comes EMC Core. Prepare Antimatter Pellet through the SPS in chapter 08 and obtain Calorite Ingot in the space branch. Gaia Ingot is also part of the core recipe.

quest.513011E734464E5D.quest_desc: The first material milestone opens basic industry. Start in chapter 03: produce steel, treated wood and an Immersive Engineering Iron Mechanical Component.
One recipe yields 2 chassis from 4 steel plates, 2 treated planks, 2 copper wire coils and 1 iron component. Hold the completed chassis before spending it on machines.

Next comes Precision Mechanism. Establish Mekanism and Ender IO alloys, then use chapter 12 to prepare quartz, presses and an Inscriber for processors. That quartz preparation is already available after the chassis.
Nearby projects show applications of this stage. Completing every item in the mod catalogues is not a prerequisite for the next material milestone.
